consigna: One sustained spoken production of at least ten minutes: raise a problem with someone who can fix it, give them feedback on how it has been handled, and say what you want — including one understated remark. With a person or recorded alone. Notes are preparation, not a script.
requisitos: A complaint in the order facts, effect, specific request (week 21)
Feedback on behaviour and impact, never character (week 16)
Two ways of holding the floor and one repair out loud (week 14)
One regret chain: wish, modal perfect, third conditional (week 17)
Two understatements that read as criticism (week 18)
Five spoken discourse markers, including one marked digression and a return (week 20)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread the corrections from weeks 14 to 21 and note the most frequent one.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences carrying feedback, a regret and an understatement together.
*Fri (10 min).* Record the ten minutes. Afterwards find the point where the structure first slipped.
autochequeo: Are all six skills present, or does one dominate?
Did the request survive all the understatement?
Did I repair out loud instead of starting the sentence again?
Were the markers spoken ones, not written ones?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: complaining, constructive feedback, conversation management, the regret cluster, understatement and spoken discourse markers. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed. (3) Give me one sentence carrying three of them. Correct nothing outside these six areas. ---
